note: Untested in a full run: half of watery-tardigrade, 50M parameters with 32K-token windows, sized for about 8 GB of GPU memory, trained with --recompute --micro-batch 1. Layer 4 is DeepSeek-V4's CSA (4 heads of 128 sharing one key-value head, an indexer of 5 heads of 128 and top 40, V4-Flash's scaled to the width), layer 8 is HCA, and the MTP block's attention is a 128-token window. On an integrated Radeon 860M, one 32K window of random tokens peaked at 6.6 GiB; it is meant for a stronger GPU. Its data is the classics for now (about 4.3M tokens, so the model mostly memorizes); it changes once a larger mixture exists. Its training is one stage: 300 steps of 8 windows of 32K tokens; DeepSeek-V4's stages to 1M tokens are not set yet. A GPU where 32K tokens do not fit trains it the same with --segment 8192 or --strategy split (docs/training.md, "Long windows").
